# Jewelry Design Templates

![_Templates.  Jewelry Templates. Jewelry Design Templates. AP | Pivtorak.Studio. 30.10.2026_ © Anna Pivtorak (Kostyuk)](/images/templates-jewelry-templates-jewelry-design-templates.webp)

Jewelry design templates are designed to support the creative development and planning of jewelry pieces. They provide structured worksheets for exploring concepts, sketching ideas, developing proportions, comparing shapes, and planning the arrangement of gemstones and other decorative elements.

These templates are intended for jewelry designers, students, and craftspeople. They help organize the design process, document ideas, and explore different design solutions before moving on to technical drawings and production.

**Formats:** Printable and fillable PDF worksheets; digital worksheets where applicable.

## Jewelry Concept Development

Worksheets for developing initial jewelry concepts, defining design ideas, collecting visual references, and recording key details of a proposed piece.

## Ring Design

A worksheet for exploring ring designs through sketches, proportions, shapes, settings, and alternative design solutions.

## Pendant and Necklace Design

Worksheets for developing pendant and necklace designs, exploring proportions, overall composition, shapes, and the arrangement of decorative elements.

## Earring Design

A worksheet for exploring earring designs, including shape, proportions, symmetry, paired elements, and different design options.

## Design Variations and Composition

A worksheet for exploring alternative design directions, experimenting with visual composition, and organizing different elements into a coherent jewelry design.

## Design Variation Sheet

A worksheet for recording, comparing, and refining several design variations of the same jewelry piece.

## Gemstone Layout Exploration Sheet

A worksheet for exploring gemstone placement, arrangement, size relationships, spacing, and composition within a jewelry design.

Jewelry Design Templates — a collection of elegant jewelry design worksheets featuring concept development, ring, pendant, necklace and earring sketches, design variations, and gemstone layout exploration.
